description.value:
You channel the power of the aspects of the storm through a bladed weapon, specializing in the frigid depths of oceans or the electrifying sparks of lightning. If you choose this manafont archetype, you must select the Arcblade Dedication as your 2nd level class feat.

Prerequisites You must be trained in either Acrobatics or Athletics, and you must have at least a +2 attribute modifier for your Strength or Dexterity. You must have a class that features a form of a state of heightened power, that can be readily expended through actions you take; such as a Swashbuckler with Panache and their Finishers, a Dervish with Zeal and Zeniths, or a Kineticist with Channel Elements and Overflows. If you are a Kineticist, you must have either the Air or Water kinetic gates, and you must choose one aspect of the storm that matches these gates.

Arcblade Adjustments Choose one of the two aspects of the storm to embody: Aspect of Tides or Aspect of Skies. If you select Tides, your Aspect damage and trait is Cold. If you select Skies, your Aspect damage and trait is Electricity. If an Arcblade feature makes a creature need to make a saving throw, they roll against your Class DC or Spell DC, whichever is higher.

Some Arcblade features have the Charge and Discharge trait. You can only use actions with the Charge trait when you are in a state of heightened power, such as when you have Panache for Swashbucklers or are channeling elements for Kineticists. When you use an action with the Discharge trait, this action also gains the trait that corresponds to your class’s method of expending your state of heightened power, such as Finisher for Swashbucklers or Overflows for Kineticists.

If you are a Kineticist, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Gvx8Mdg5mxUtTD5g]{Weapon Infusion} feat. If an Arcblade feature calls for a Strike, you can substitute it for a 1-action melee Elemental Blast, and you can use Weapon Infusion prior to the attack. If you are any other class, you gain your choice of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.gt9pvIicabSOe6pB]{Brutish Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.s9HfXqxNHYD8X291]{Flash Fang} feat. You gain familiarity with weapons in the Sword and Spear groups, treating Advanced Weapons in these groups as Martial weapons and Martial weapons in these groups as Simple weapons for the purpose of proficiency. You gain access to these weapons.
